title: Editing a posted expense (amount 230 to 300, date, treasury to the bank account): both systems end with cost 260.87, tax 39.13 and the bank credited with 300; the reference system edits the journal in place and works the tax out again, this application reverses the journal and posts it again with the tax that was typed

edit_steps.note: Expense 000004 edited step by step: no change, amount 230 to 300, a tax of 45 typed, date 27/10 to 26/10, treasury to the bank account and back; the same journal 000141 edited in place each time, with no reversing journal and no new number

cases.reason: The reference system edits the journal of an expense in place and keeps only a log of the lines it changed. The owner decided (E15) that a posted journal is never edited: a change that touches the entry reverses it and posts the next revision.

The reference system does not keep a tax typed on the edit of an expense: it works the tax out again as 15% of the amount (39.13 of 300), so the 45 that was typed was lost. This application keeps the tax that was typed and the cost is what is left (255.00).
